start.text: A rowboat tied to the staithe's first post: clinker-built and tarred, its stem standing a hand's width proud. Saltmarrow-built. Rain in the bilge, the oars shipped neatly, as if whoever left it meant to come back.
Somebody has whittled a gull into the top of the stem post, small and quick, wings half open.
You think of Saltmarrow's harbor, and of Mara's brother, who went north.
It puts you in mind of something on Saltmarrow. A stool by a door? It won't come.
